_comment: Reviewed default price table that init, setup tokenomics and upgrade write into config.yaml as observability.pricing. It is only a seed: the gateway never reads this file and compiles no price into a binary; it prices from the table in config.yaml. USD per million tokens, public list prices from the vendors' official pricing pages (_sources names the page and the date each row was checked). A model with no row has no cost (unknown_model: omit), never a guessed one. Edit the table in config.yaml; bump version when you change it.
